description: PX4 x500 (NXP HoverGames-class 500 mm quad X) as parameterized in PX4-gazebo-models. Coefficients are simulator defaults identical to RotorS defaults (RotorS license is from file headers/package metadata only, no top-level LICENSE; no RotorS meshes are bundled); no published system identification of physical x500 hardware was found.

PX4GZ.license: BSD-3-Clause (repo LICENSE: PX4 Autopilot for Drones 2022; models/x500/LICENSE: Rudis Laboratories 2022)
PX4GZ.meshLicense: x500_base meshes (NXP-HGD-CF.dae, 5010Base/Bell.dae, 1345_prop_*.stl) carry no separate notice; covered only by directory/repo BSD-3-Clause. Not imported; re-verify before any mesh port.

GZSIM.note: Force law reference only (thrust = kf w^2, drag torque = -dir*kf w^2*km, rotor drag = -|w| lambda1 v_perp, rolling moment = -|w| mu1 v_perp). Read, not executed.

inertia.locator: x500_base/model.sdf base_link <inertia>; rotor link inertia neglected (<3e-5 each)

rotor_radius.locator: inferred from mesh name 1345_prop (13 in diameter); not a stated parameter

drag_linear.locator: x500 SDF has no body drag; rotor drag only

rotors.name: rotor_0
rotors.locator: rotor_0 link pose; turningDirection ccw; motorNumber 0 (front-right)

notes: Rotor z offset 0.06 m is relative to the base_link origin; the base_link CoM is at the origin in the SDF.
rotorVelocitySlowdownSim=10 is a Gazebo visualization/aliasing device; the force law uses the real rotor speed.
Hover rotor speed ~ sqrt(m g / 4 kf) = 769 rad/s, thrust-to-weight ~1.69 at omega_max.
